name: Dave Hennefer
title: Project Management
bio: David A. Hennefer, is a Project Manager with a focus on the development of industrial parks and bulk distribution facilities in Utah. Prior to joining the Ritchie Group, Dave served as Executive Vice-President of Equitec Financial Group, a New York Stock Exchange company based in Oakland California, and as President of Equitec Properties Company, a wholly owned subsidiary, with 2500 employees and with 4 billion of real estate holdings located nationally in most major metropolitan cities. He served in this position for 10 years. Dave was recruited to become the President and CEO of Pacific Eagle Holdings, where he would serve for next 22 years. Pacific Eagle Holding was a large US national real estate company which was a wholly owned subsidiary of the Great Eagle Holdings Corporation, a public company listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange. At the time Dave Joined the Ritchie Group, he was serving as Executive Vice President of Coldwell Banker in Utah. Dave Graduated from Brigham Young University in 1972 with a Bachelor of Science Degree in Sociology.
